method: independent PPO (IPPO-style) per house; single level only. Original May & Huang has a bi-level price-planner agent with continuous price action; we reproduce the prosumer-level PPO mechanism only - the price-planner is out of scope given no price mechanism in our environment (documented adaptation).
reward: r_i,t = comfort_i,t + Jain_fairness_t (raw, GAE credit assignment)
observation: [hour/24, battery_frac, demand_norm, solar_norm, community_surplus_norm] per house
architecture: 2-layer MLP (32-32, tanh), shared trunk, actor head (3 logits) + critic head (value); independent nets per house
